[b]CIVILIAN CASUALTIES REPORTED IN JUANE ISLAND BOMBARDMENT
[/b]
[i]The Gendarmite government officially releases confirmed casualties after Bravanorian missile attacks bombard islands. Military officials reported that over 70% of the missiles were intercepted, 25% missed their target, and the remaining 5% were able to strike crucial infrastructure. This has led to over 15 different strikes hitting Civilian Infrastructure, Military Quarters, Logistical Centers, and Commercial Ports. The Gendarmite governer of Alicia  and Capricorn Étienne Leclerc strongly condemns the attacks and has released a statement in proportion to the attacks. 

"[b]This afternoon, invaders from a foreign land decided to cross a line of war that we never expected them to cross. These Aliens attacked our Civilians in their sleep, killing and separating families, relationships, and animals. Such atrocities have never been seen in legitimate Gendarmite territory since the 1967 Capricornian coup. These actions will not evade justice, we will make sure these pigs get hit with ten fold of what they could dish out. They have escalated the war and crossed moral boundaries - and soon they will figure out about the consequences of committing such wicked actions. Dieu est avec Gendarme![/b]" 

End of statement[/i]

[b]Casualties Listed[/b]

[i]-9 Civillians
-17 Soldiers
-10 Missing Persons[/i]

[nation]Demste[/nation]
